WITH ShortestLap AS (
    SELECT
        drivers.forename,
        drivers.surname,
        lapTimes.time,
        MIN(STRFTIME('%M:%S', STR_TIME(lapTimes.time))) AS shortest_lap_time
    FROM
        lapTimes
    JOIN
        drivers ON lapTimes.driverId = drivers.driverId
    GROUP BY
        drivers.forename,
        drivers.surname,
        lapTimes.time
    HAVING
        MIN(STRFTIME('%M:%S', STR_TIME(lapTimes.time))) = (
            SELECT MIN(STRFTIME('%M:%S', STR_TIME(time))) FROM lapTimes
        )
)
SELECT
    forename,
    surname
FROM
    ShortestLap
WHERE
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY STRFTIME('%M:%S', STR_TIME(shortest_lap_time)) ASC) <= 20;

    last_driver_time,

    SELECT
      lap_times.time AS time,

          )
      ) AS champion_time

    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = '2008 Australian Grand Prix')
  )
)

SELECT DistrictName, first_name, last_name
FROM (
    SELECT
        DistrictName,
        SUBSTR(first_name, 1, INSTR(first_name, ' ') - 1) AS first_name,
        SUBSTR(last_name, 1, INSTR(last_name, ' ') - 1) AS last_name
    FROM schools
    JOIN frm ON schools.CDSCode = frm.CDSCode
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            sname,
            MAX(NumGE1500) AS max_num_ge_1500
        FROM satscores
        JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
        GROUP BY sname
    ) highest_scores ON schools.SchoolName = highest_scores.sname
)
WHERE NumGE1500 = max_num_ge_1500;

extracted_sql:
SELECT users.Id
FROM users
JOIN (
    SELECT PostId, COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) AS UserCount
    FROM postHistory
    GROUP BY PostId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) = 1
) AS post_history_count
ON users.Id = post_history_count.PostId
JOIN (
    SELECT PostId, SUM(ViewCount) AS TotalViews
    FROM posts
    GROUP BY PostId
    HAVING SUM(ViewCount) >= 1000
) AS post_views
ON users.Id = post_views.PostId
GROUP BY users.Id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT post_history_count.PostId) = 1 AND SUM(post_views.TotalViews) >= 1000;

        s.NCESSchool,

    GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.NCESSchool, s.SOCType, ss.cname

WHERE Rank <= 5;

SELECT s.NCESSchool, s.SOCType
FROM schools s
JOIN (
    SELECT cds, CountyCode, AVG(AvgScrRead) as AvgReadingScore
    FROM satscores
    JOIN schools sch ON satscores.cds = sch.CDSCode
    GROUP BY cds, CountyCode
    HAVING AVG(AvgScrRead) >= (
        SELECT AVG(AvgScrRead)
        FROM satscores s2
        JOIN schools sch2 ON s2.cds = sch2.CDSCode
        WHERE sch2.Virtual = 'F' AND sch2.CountyCode = sch.CountyCode
    )
) ranked_schools ON sch.CDSCode = ranked_schools.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY s.NCESSchool, s.SOCType
HAVING COUNT(s.NCESSchool) <= 5;
